10xteam-10xteam:ashbyhq:7060f11d-ee69-46.description: Updated: 07 July 2026 Freelance | 8–20 hrs/week | Remote (EU/UK) Are you an experienced specialist in eIDAS2 and Qualified Electronic Signatures (QES), passionate about advancing AI-driven legal technology? Do you have 8–20 hours per week to contribute alongside your current commitments? Join 10x Team and help shape how AI understands and applies digital identity and electronic signature standards in real-world scenarios. About the Role 10x Team connects expert freelance professionals with leading AI labs to build next-generation solutions. We are seeking skilled consultants in eIDAS2 and Qualified Electronic Signatures (EU/UK) to enhance the quality, technical accuracy, and regulatory alignment of AI-driven systems. Key Responsibilities: - Review and refine AI-generated content related to eIDAS2, QES, implementation guidelines, compliance scenarios, and practical best practices - Assess AI outputs for technical, legal, and regulatory accuracy and ensure alignment with current eIDAS2 standards - Develop realistic scenarios illustrating digital identity, trust services, and signature workflows using your professional expertise - Draft scenario variations representing the perspectives of regulators, service providers, and end users - Identify and correct gaps, inaccuracies, or faulty reasoning in AI-created material - Apply your knowledge to ensure AI training data mirrors authentic regulatory analysis, processes, and documentation About You: - Senior-level specialist with substantial professional experience in eIDAS2, Qualified Electronic Signatures, and digital trust frameworks in the EU or UK - Deep understanding of compliance, standards, and real-world case applications - Skilled in critiquing documents, compliance materials, and regulatory frameworks - Organized, detail-oriented, and able to provide actionable feedback independently - Available 8–20 hours weekly and able to respond promptly - Residency in the UK or EU is required Why Join 10x Team? - Flexible, fully remote freelance work that fits your schedule - Contribute directly to AI systems powering secure digital identity and trust solutions - Free access to our in-house AI Academy to deepen your AI expertise - Structured onboarding, clear project briefs, and ongoing collaboration How to Apply: After applying, you’ll receive an email detailing the steps to: - ⁠Complete a short written assessment - Participate in an AI-powered interview Important: Your application is only complete once you finish all steps via the email link. Please note: these AI Lab missions are not traditional job openings with fixed start dates. Project demand is highly dynamic and matching depends on your expertise, availability, and current AI Lab needs. Some experts are matched within days, while others may wait longer for a suitable project. Help drive the future of AI-powered digital trust. Apply today and join 10x Team! #LI-TT1 ----------------------------------------- NOTE At 10x, there are two types of opportunities: 1. Traditional freelance missions These are regular project-based opportunities where the listed mission is the actual project you may work on. 2. AI Lab roles For AI Lab roles, we scout, review, and approve profiles for access to future project opportunities. The missions listed for AI Lab roles are not traditional job openings. AI Lab work is often highly confidential as this exposes information of what an AI Lab is working on, and project requests are unpredictable. When an AI Lab request comes in, we often need to respond within 24 hours with suitable talent. Matching depends on the specific needs of each AI Lab project and your niche expertise. Once your profile is reviewed and approved, you may be matched to relevant AI Lab projects when suitable opportunities arise. This can happen within hours, but it may also take months, depending on the researchers at the AI labs and their project needs.

flynncompanies-flynncompanies:lever:42c1.description: Job Summary: Commercial Roofing Superintendent is responsible for overseeing and managing commercial roofing projects from start to finish, ensuring quality, safety, and productivity standards are met. This role supervises crews, coordinates job site activities, and ensures projects are completed on time and within scope. Responsibilities include new installations, re-roofing, repairs, and maintenance of commercial roofing systems, including TPO, PVC, EPDM, modified bitumen, and metal roofing systems. The Superintendent will also be responsible for quality control, safety compliance, and customer communication across multiple job sites. What We Offer: • Competitive salary: $90,000 – $100,000 annually (DOE) • Multiple wage reviews throughout the year • Comprehensive PAID benefits – health, dental, and vision • Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance • Life and AD&D Insurance • 401k with company match • Company-provided smartphone and computer • Opportunities for career advancement • Training, mobile apps, and development programs through Flynn University What We Are Seeking: • 2+ years of superintendent experience in commercial roofing (REQUIRED) • Strong hands-on knowledge of commercial roofing systems: TPO, PVC, EPDM, Modified Bitumen, metal roofing, and coatings • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, specifications, and project plans • Experience managing crews, subcontractors, and job site operations • Strong understanding of safety practices, OSHA compliance, and job site procedures • Ability to perform inspections, identify issues (leaks, defects), and implement repairs • Experience with installation of insulation, vapor barriers, flashing, and waterproofing systems • Proficiency with tools and equipment such as hot air welders, hand torches, spray equipment, compressors, and power tools • Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills • Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment • Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record (required) • Open to traveling for extended periods Key Responsibilities: • Supervise and coordinate all roofing activities on job sites • Ensure projects are completed safely, on time, and within budget • Lead and mentor crews while maintaining productivity and quality standards • Conduct site inspections and ensure compliance with project specifications • Communicate regularly with project managers, clients, and team members • Maintain accurate project documentation and reporting • Enforce safety protocols and company policies at all times #LI-DNI 07/02/26

jobgether-jobgether:lever:3a56e32b-f4a6-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Engineering based in Switzerland. As Head of Engineering, you’ll help transform a strong engineering team into a scalable, structured, and high-performing technology organisation. You’ll sit between senior technology leadership and engineering teams, translating business priorities into realistic plans while strengthening delivery predictability and ownership. The role combines people leadership, organisational design, strategic planning, and enough technical depth to guide complex engineering decisions. You’ll shape leadership layers, hiring plans, engineering standards, and processes as the organisation enters an ambitious phase of growth. Your work will directly influence reliability, product delivery, team development, and the ability to scale sustainably. This is a high-impact opportunity for an experienced engineering leader who thrives in founder-led, fast-moving, remote-first environments. Lead and scale the engineering organisation, with a strong focus on people leadership, organisational structure, accountability, and predictable delivery. Own engineering delivery at an organisational level, including capacity planning, prioritisation, roadmap feasibility, resource allocation, and dependency management. Directly manage and develop engineering leaders, including Tech Leads and QA Leads, while evolving leadership structures as the organisation grows. Partner closely with senior technology, product, and business leaders to translate strategic priorities into clear engineering plans, realistic timelines, and informed trade-offs. Establish clear standards for architecture, quality, reliability, security, and engineering practices, enabling teams to operate with increasing autonomy. Maintain accountability for overall service reliability by establishing clear ownership, escalation processes, monitoring, and continuous improvement practices. Lead engineering hiring, onboarding, performance management, succession planning, and career development to support sustainable growth. Build additional engineering capabilities beyond feature teams, including architecture, security, compliance, platform engineering, and other cross-functional technical disciplines. Strengthen engineering processes, decision-making frameworks, and accountability mechanisms to reduce dependency on individual contributors and founders. Support financial and headcount planning across the engineering organisation. Foster a culture of clarity, ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement, and high-quality execution. Remain technically engaged enough to understand complex topics, challenge assumptions, support sound decisions, and provide guidance when required. Requirements: 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including hands-on experience building and operating production web-based systems. 4+ years of engineering leadership experience in roles such as Engineering Manager, Head of Engineering, or Tech Lead with significant people-management responsibility. Demonstrated ownership of people leadership, engineering delivery, capacity planning, prioritisation, and organisational development. Strong experience leading senior engineers and technical leaders and helping them develop into broader leadership roles. Proven experience working closely with founders or executive leadership during periods of organisational growth and transformation. Strong background in delivery leadership and planning within SaaS, product-focused, or similarly fast-paced environments. Experience with engineering financial planning, headcount planning, and resource allocation. Strong communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical stakeholders. Solid understanding of security fundamentals and secure software delivery practices. jobgether-jobgether:lever:5ece38d3-c74a-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Associate Technical Consultant based in India. This is an early-career technology opportunity for a talented programmer looking to build expertise in enterprise cloud solutions and customer-focused technical delivery. You will contribute to the development of complex solutions, working with configuration, custom development, integrations, APIs, and data migration. The role offers hands-on exposure to modern technologies including JavaScript, Lightning Web Components, Apex, and integration tools. You will collaborate with technical teams and product specialists to solve challenging implementation and debugging issues. Working across global teams, you will gain experience delivering solutions for customers across different geographies. This is an excellent opportunity for recent engineering graduates to develop strong consulting, programming, and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced technology environment. Support the technical delivery of standard configurations, custom development, integrations, and data migration components within enterprise platform implementations. Develop and contribute to complex technical solutions using relevant platform products, APIs, programming languages, and front-end technologies. Work with source code, version control systems, and established code deployment and development standards. Analyze project requirements and technical issues, deep-dive into problems, and debug solutions to identify and resolve defects efficiently. Collaborate with technical consultants, engineers, product teams, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality customer solutions. Liaise with product teams when required to investigate technical challenges and support successful customer implementations. Contribute to integration and ETL activities, ensuring data and systems are connected effectively. Work collaboratively with global delivery teams across different geographies and adapt working hours when business needs require flexibility. Continuously develop technical knowledge and consulting capabilities through hands-on project experience, mentorship, and collaboration with experienced professionals. jobgether-jobgether:lever:af45ad95-4fd5-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Finance based in Canada. This is a senior leadership opportunity to build and lead a modern Finance function within a fast-growing international payments environment. You will own management reporting, financial control, budgeting, settlements, cash-flow planning, and financial process optimization. The role combines strategic leadership with hands-on ownership of financial models, reporting logic, reconciliations, and operational controls. You will partner closely with Data, Development, Treasury, and executive leadership to turn complex financial information into actionable business insights. A key focus will be replacing manual processes with reliable, automated reporting and scalable financial workflows. You will also oversee financial operations across multiple legal entities, currencies, products, merchants, and payment methods. This role is ideal for an experienced finance leader who thrives on ownership, transformation, and working in a data-driven, international environment. Own end-to-end management reporting, including P&L, Cash Flow Statement, Balance Sheet, plan-vs-actual analysis, and profitability reporting across products, merchants, payment methods, and legal entities. Build and maintain the budgeting and forecasting cycle, including operating budgets, payment calendars, cash-flow forecasts, gap analysis, scenario planning, and obligation tracking. Design and operate a robust financial control framework covering regular reconciliations, discrepancy classification, resolution SLAs, approval workflows, audit trails, and manual adjustment controls. Manage merchant settlements, including settlement calculations, provider fees, minimum fees, surcharges, refunds, chargebacks, FX conversions, and balance transfers. Oversee finance across multiple legal entities, currencies, and intercompany transactions, including consolidated reporting and preparation of information for statutory accounting and external audits. Serve as the business owner for financial automation by defining financial logic, KPIs, formulas, data sources, requirements, and acceptance criteria for dashboards and reports. Collaborate with Data Analysts, Data Engineers, and Development teams to validate financial outputs, identify discrepancies, and prioritize automation initiatives based on business impact. Lead, structure, and develop the Finance team by defining responsibilities, hiring where needed, establishing accountability, and driving continuous process improvement. Report financial performance, risks, forecasts, and business insights to the CEO, founders, and senior leadership in clear, commercially focused language. Establish clear operating boundaries between Finance, Treasury, and Data while maintaining effective collaboration across these functions. Develop a scalable Finance function capable of supporting growth across multiple markets, entities, currencies, and transaction volumes. Requirements 8+ years of experience in Finance, including at least 3 years managing a finance team or function. Professional background in fintech, payments/PSP, acquiring, EMI, banking, crypto payments, or another high-volume transactional business. Proven experience building or transforming financial processes, particularly moving from manual Excel-based reporting toward automated data pipelines and reporting. Strong experience managing multiple legal entities, currencies, and intercompany operations. Hands-on ownership of P&L, Cash Flow, Balance Sheet, plan-vs-actual reporting, and financial forecasting. Ability to define financial metrics, establish standardized calculation methodologies, and develop unit economics and profitability analysis by product, customer, channel, or business line. Strong understanding of payment flows, including settlement cycles, provider fees, processing and clearing costs, refunds, chargeback

jobgether-jobgether:lever:d2f205ca-f06b-.title: #49426 Video Annotation & Data Labeling Project
jobgether-jobgether:lever:d2f205ca-f06b-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a #49426 Video Annotation & Data Labeling Project based in Italy. Join a long-term AI data project focused on transforming video content into high-quality training data for advanced AI systems. You will work on video captioning, timeline segmentation, action labeling, and AI-generated content verification. The role requires exceptional attention to detail and the ability to describe only what can be objectively verified on screen. You will follow precise annotation guidelines while maintaining strong accuracy, consistency, and productivity. Successful contributors can gain priority access to more advanced and higher-paid AI data projects. The project provides structured onboarding and certification to help you master the required workflows and quality standards. It is an opportunity to contribute directly to the development and improvement of next-generation AI models while working within a quality-focused environment. Write concise 1–2 sentence summaries of video action sequences using simple, objective English and following strict annotation guidelines. Segment video timelines into discrete, action-based sections, ensuring a minimum of 2–3 segments per task with no gaps or overlaps. Create action labels using simple present tense and describe only actions that are directly and visually verifiable. Review and edit AI-generated captions to ensure accuracy, consistency, and compliance with project guidelines. Identify and correct inconsistencies or inaccuracies in automatically generated annotations. Maintain a high level of annotation quality, targeting benchmark accuracy of 85–90% or higher. Complete annotation workflows efficiently, with an expected productivity benchmark of approximately 4 minutes per minute of video. Use keyboard shortcuts and established workflow tools to complete tasks efficiently. Run required background screen-recording software during task execution. Follow all project procedures, productivity expectations, quality standards, and certification requirements. Maintain concentration and consistency throughout repetitive, detail-oriented annotation tasks. Requirements Strong attention to detail and a demonstrated ability to identify subtle differences or inconsistencies in visual content. Ability to describe only what is visibly observable without assumptions, interpretations, or inferred information. Strong written English skills and the ability to communicate actions using clear, simple, and consistent language. Ability to follow detailed guidelines precisely and apply the same rules consistently across a large volume of tasks. Strong accuracy and quality orientation, with the ability to achieve and maintain an 85–90%+ benchmark accuracy level. Ability to work efficiently toward productivity targets and complete a 1-minute video annotation workflow in approximately 4 minutes. Comfortable learning and using keyboard shortcuts and structured digital workflows. Ability to run background screen-recording software while completing assigned tasks. Strong focus and discipline when working on repetitive, quality-sensitive activities. Comfortable working independently within a structured, process-driven environment. Willingness to complete an approximately 3-hour certification and onboarding process. Ability to review training materials, complete practice tasks, and successfully pass 5 certification tasks within the required 4-minute-per-video time limit. Benefits Competitive project-based rate of $2.00–$5.00 per hour , depending on verified quality and productivity. One-time $10 bonus via PayPal after successfully completing the certification process. Access to upcoming batches of paid annotation tasks after certification. Priority access to more advanced and higher-paid AI data projects for successful contributors. Structured onboarding with guidelines, training videos, practice tasks
